messages:
oncall-bot: INCIDENT ALERT: [P1] inference-api - elevated 5xx rate in us-east-1. Paging: @alex (primary oncall). Incident ticket: INC-2026-037. Please ack within 5m.

alex: Ack. Investigating. Noted clients seeing 502 / 504. Rate spiked ~09:12 UTC. Starting triage.

mira: Seeing increased tail latency on pod-group inference-rt-5. KV cache misses spiked right before errors. Could be upstream storage or a network flake.

sam: Logs show gateway errors: `upstream connect error or disconnect/reset before headers`. Matches a control-plane LB symptom. Reached out to cloud provider support via GTicket #GT-987654.

alex: Good. @mira @sam please capture sample spans/traces and add to incident doc. I'll open a vendor escalation call. Estimated customer impact: in-flight requests failing + retries causing higher latencies; affecting hosted customers in us-east-1 (~20% of traffic).

casey: Posting draft status page & customer notification below. Ping if edits. /cc @josh for CS templating.

casey: ```
Status page (draft):
- Summary: We are investigating elevated error rates for Redwood Hosted inference in us-east-1. Some requests are returning 5xx errors.
- Impact: A subset of hosted customers in us-east-1 may experience failed requests or increased latency.
- Mitigation: We have applied fallback routing for critical traffic to dedicated pools and are working with our cloud provider on a control-plane fix.
- Next update: in 15 minutes or when we have vendor ETA.

Customer email template (draft):
Subject: Service disruption affecting Redwood Hosted inference (us-east-1)
Hi <Customer>,
We’re investigating a service disruption impacting some Hosted inference requests in us-east-1. Our engineers have applied a mitigation for critical workloads and are working with the cloud provider on a fix. We’ll follow up with timing and recommended actions.
What you can do: Consider routing critical requests to your Dedicated pool or retry with exponential backoff.
We’ll share updates via status.redwood.com and direct email.
Regards,
Redwood Inference Status Team
```

josh: LGTM. Add note about automatic fallback to smaller model variant in the hosted API for critical tenants (helps reduce tokens in-flight and retries).

sam: Cloud provider support replied: initial triage shows a "networking control-plane event" in region, assigned to L3. Provider asked for pcap + example flow. Preparing sanitized captures and will upload to their secure bucket.

alex: Ok. Also enable Canary fallback route to Dedicated pool for high-tier customers; running command now:```sh
rdxctl route set --service inference-api --fallback dedicated-pool --region us-east-1 --force
```

deploy-bot: deploy started: route change commit rdx-2026-03-15-482 (initiated by alex).

mira: Route change applied. Telemetry: diverted traffic shows 60% reduction in 5xx for those sessions, overall error-rate dropped from ~15% to ~6%. Still watching for recurrence.

alex: Update on escalation: provider assigned internal case INC-PR-1122, L3 on call. They requested our ASG scaling events, control-plane logs, and recent LB controller metrics; shared via secure link. Vendor call scheduled 09:32 UTC — @sam please lead.

sam: On vendor call now. Provider confirms a control-plane regression affecting LB controller reconciliation. They estimate mitigation roll-forward in 30-45m. They asked us to keep fallback routes active until they confirm stability.

alex: Action items: 1) @mira continue monitoring latency and share traces to the incident doc; 2) @casey finalize customer emails and send to affected tenant list once legal clears; 3) @josh prep CS playbook for inbound tickets; 4) @sam maintain vendor liaison and post updates. If handing off, include current state.

casey: Draft sent to legal for review — expect signoff in ~8m. Draft attributes root cause to vendor network control-plane regression and includes mitigation + workaround + ETA window.

josh: Oncall handoff at 10:00 UTC — I'll take over from 10:00 for 4 hours. @alex can you summarize current state for handoff?

alex: Handoff summary:
- Incident: INC-2026-037 (P1)
- Symptom: Elevated 5xx in us-east-1 due to provider control-plane LB regression
- Mitigation: Fallback routing to dedicated-pool applied (route rdx-2026-03-15-482) — immediate improvement observed (~60% drop for diverted traffic)
- Vendor status: Provider L3 engaged, roll-forward fix ETA 30-45m from 09:32 UTC
- Customer comms: Status draft ready, customer email pending legal review
- Next checks: Watch error-rate; if <1% for 15m, prepare to mark resolved and instruct provider to rollback fallback.

deploy-bot: route change completed: rdx-2026-03-15-482 -> success.

mira: Monitoring shows stability trend but still sampling a small tail (errors ~1.8%). Keeping alert thresholds lower for next 30m. Will escalate if provider signals unexpected changes.

alex: :thumbsup: Thanks team. I'll join vendor verification at 09:58 UTC before signoff. If provider confirms LB controller healthy and our error-rate <1% for 15m, we will post "resolved" on the status page and send final customer update.

oncall-bot: NOTE: If you need to escalate to Execs, use the template in /playbooks/incidents/exec-escalation.txt and ping #incidents-exec.

alex: Copy. Will update in-channel and close incident doc when resolved.
